## findings

1. **SOURCE-TASK RED — a second complete solution with different scored values.** Symptom: P4 on line 2 alone, then P6, then P7 satisfies every prerequisite sentence and books 268.80 / 3778.56 / 2519.04 against the gold's 940.80 + 1209.60 / 5391.36 / 3594.24. Root cause: `_difficulty.md` G-1 (two writes bring E4/E6's state about) and G-4 (the `condition` "on every paid line" is stronger than the sentence "the highest-numbered / last paid day line"); the "every paid day line" requirement lives only inside the daily-allowed factor's tier, which an agent satisfies or not by its own choice of filings. Evidence: P6 rule (extended.yaml 2034–2037), P7 rule (2330–2332), P4 rule (1535–1536), P5 rule (1773–1779); seed lines `f0e365c6`, `6ae7c05b`. Affected: P6 `prerequisite[0]`, P7 `prerequisite[1]` (condition vs policy_source), P4 rule scope; `1.json` evaluation_criteria steps 11, 13, 15, 17, design_rationale problem-tree card, argument_uniqueness_tracing of step 11. First audit.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — E4/E6 resolvable by two writes; condition strengthened beyond its sentence.** The charter-global finding G-1/G-4; its cost to this task is finding 1.
3. **SOURCE-POLICY RED — undeclared override of base "Amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount are never in dispute."** (G-6). On this world the facility is `non_network_nonparticipating`; the P6/P7 baseline sentence "Those days are valued at the facility's billed amount per covered day on the stay" values the days at 1650.00 against a stay allowed of 1312.00, putting 338.00 a day billed above the allowed amount in dispute. The task's declared fall-backs `baseline_result` 23100.00 (P6) and 33000.00 (P7) rest on that billed rate; a reader of the baseline document and the unsuperseded base sentence does not reach them, and caps the rate at the allowed 1312.00 — the daily-allowed factor's own tier 2 — so the "definite wrong fall-back" of `sl_daily_allowed_source` / `ex_daily_allowed_source` is not definite. Gold itself (1480.00 per day, an allowed rate) is unaffected. Affected: P6/P7 `rule` and `baseline.rule`, `overwrite` (supersedes only the authorization clause); `1.json` computations[2..3].baseline_result.
4. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — ladder reality (G-7, G-8).** The payment-method tier 2 of all four computations is conditioned on `tricare_secondary_to_ohi`, true for all six Select tiers; the cost-share-percentage ladder of all four computations has a tier 2 ("network … basis is a percentage of the allowed amount") that no Select tier can reach (`inpatient_network_basis` ∈ {per_diem_with_minimum, lesser_of_per_diem_or_pct, per_admission_copay}). This world's tiers taken are tier 2 (payment method; decided by the OHI amount alone) and tier 1 (non-network 20 %). Counting only surviving factors: P4 and P5 drop from 5 to 3 (2 parameter, 1 method), below the floor of 4; P6 and P7 drop from 6 to 4 and stay within bounds. Every declared factor does move its number on this world (frozen § factor_weight; equal to `factor_sensitivity`). 5. Observation — reclassified from the frozen section: G-2 (P6/P7 `COUNT` on `appeal_cases` is holding-scoped under the DSL's documented contract "HID the primary id of the holding in this category") does not change this task's scored values because the gold evaluates P5–P7 with the customer id as `target_holding_id`, which the gate resolves through its "search all tables" fallback.
